summary: The SiteProfileHistory represents the history of changes made to site profiles, including actions taken by users and system administrators on various sections of the site profile interface.
purpose: To track and record the history of user actions and changes made to site profiles for auditing and review purposes.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistorySearch
steps: Execute database procedure and retrieve results as SqlDataReader.
Read each record and fill SiteProfileHistory list.

calculations.description: Format ActionDate to a short date format using DateFormatter.
Construct AgencyUserFormatted combining agency and user initials.
Format name and add agency name and phone details in AgencyUserDetailsFormatted.

conditions: ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID is different from ByOriginalUserID.
system_behavior: Rendering actions and details for history tracking.
